indications.description: Adjuvant treatment of muscle-invasive and/or node-positive, non-metastatic predominantly transitional-cell upper-tract urothelial carcinoma after surgery.

treatment.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² IV on days 1 and 8 and cisplatin 70 mg/m² IV on day 1; every 21 days for four adjuvant cycles.

administration.note: Over 60 minutes with hydration. Four adjuvant cycles.

options.description: Fully active.

Limited self-care; bed/chair more than half of waking hours.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
premedication: Confirm the four-cycle adjuvant plan and how kidney function after surgery affects treatment selection.
other_support: Use one written anti-sickness plan, including medicines before treatment, tablets for home and rescue treatment. Your team reconciles steroids, interactions and any stomach-protection medicine from your local prescription. Cisplatin needs prescribed intravenous fluids and electrolyte monitoring/replacement. Follow your own fluid advice; tell the team about heart failure or fluid restriction. Review kidney function, hearing, nerves and other medicines before treatment. Day 8 gemcitabine has a separate lower-risk anti-sickness plan.
